title: His ten-piece band and the Tuxedo Brass Band; reel ends
summary: Howard's big band personnel, and leading the Tuxedo Brass Band with Eddie Jackson, Bat Mosley and Remus Matthews; end of reel.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever have a real big band yourself?

Yeah, I did, most of the time. I had a lot of the fellas work with me. Bill worked a long time with me, Bill Matthews. Paggio, second trumpet. Mario Custer, played saxophone and clarinet, he's a nice trumpet player too, you know. Oh I had many of them played.
What did Bill Matthews play then? Trombone.
Trombone. Who? Bill. No, I never, in fact, never did hear Trombone, or Bill played a drum, but I know he could.

I used to play with his brother in the Tuxedo Brass Band, Eddie Jackson. I led the brass band, Papa Celestine and Eddie Jackson split up. I was lead man and Paggio was second, and Duran, Maurice Duran. We two was on solo.
Who else was in the band?
Oh, I just, it's kind of weird. Well the drummers you ought to know. Well the drummers was Bat Mosley and Remus Matthews, Bill's brother. Well that was the regular guy.
That's right. Who played bass drum? Oh, Bat.
That's right. And Eddie Jackson was in there.
Yeah, he was a tuba man. Great man.
I think that's about all of this reel. Before we get into anything new, I'll turn it off.
